name: SYSTEM-G-CE-D1

config.name: SYSTEM-G-CE-D1
config.parent_source: TOP 10 unique version_ids from SYSTEM-A fused ranking (ChatGPT option B)
config.local_bm25_implementation: experiments/EXP-018B/scripts/local_bm25_batched.py Track-1 batched IDF; scoring semantics identical to per-parent lexical_search
config.L_means: ADDITIVE LOCAL PASSAGES PER QUERY after dedupe excluding A-pool-100
config.P_means: additive canonical extras after excluding C_E, ordered by best projection fused DESC then chunk_id ASC
config.union: C_E UNION C_P; C_E = A pool-100 UNION selected L=10 extras; C_P = first 20 previously absent canonical chunks from projection mapping; never drop C_E
config.merge_rrf: rrf_fuse_labelled k=60 over system_a + local_bm25:<version_id> filtered to (in A-pool-100) OR (selected L extras); keep original within-parent BM25 ranks 1..W; top_k=union size. Projection is NOT a third merge-RRF list.
config.cross_parent_order: among extras not in A-pool-100, after dedupe: round(local_BM25_score numeric 9) DESC, then chunk_id ASC
config.a_channel: E-L10 merge-RRF a_norm kept exactly; projection-only a_norm=minmax(projection-RRF) over the P extras for that query (MINMAX_DEGENERATE=0.5 if hi==lo). Two-population minmax inherited from EXP-019A; combined list is NOT re-minmaxed.
config.a_norm_C_E: keep E-L10 a_norm exactly as computed on the E-L10 pool
config.a_norm_C_P_only: minmax_norm over the P projection-only fused scores for that query; MINMAX_DEGENERATE=0.5 if constant. Replaces SYSTEM-F a_norm=0.0.
config.ce_norm: minmax over C (union); kept exactly from EXP-017 stored values (not re-minmaxed because a_norm changed)
config.ce_constructor: CrossEncoderReranker(pad='batch', bucket_by_length=True)  # D1; not fast=True; threads default 4
config.tie_break: blend DESC, E-L10 merge-RRF rank (C_P-only a_rank=10**9 after those with RRF ranks), chunk_id ASC
config.one_change_from_F: projection-only retrieval_norm = minmax(projection-RRF over P extras); E-L10 a_norm and EXP-017 CE minmax kept exactly; blend 0.7/0.3
config.ce_bucket_rule: sort by unpadded token length then original index; unpermute logits to original order
config.one_change_from_G: D1 CE padding/bucketing only; ranking semantics identical to SYSTEM-G

cross_encoder.bucket_rule: sort by unpadded token length then original index
